context: Create a production-safe autonomy policy for the dependency bumps workflow, with a conservative day-one level for a team that includes new engineers.
request: Use architecture-analyst. Use governance-review. Create a one-page autonomy policy for the following workflow: Dependency Bumps. Requirements: define multiple autonomy levels and which tasks can be performed at each level; include workflow description, autonomy levels, tasks by level, safety controls, validation requirements, escalation conditions, evidence required to move up a level, approval authority, day-one autonomy level, and day-one rationale. Save output to docs/autonomy-policy.md. Generate a JSONL audit record using interaction-logging. The audit record must reference docs/autonomy-policy.md, governance-review, and interaction-logging.

skills_used.name: architecture-review
skills_used.purpose: Review the repo context and production-risk posture for dependency bump governance.

skills_used.name: governance-review
skills_used.purpose: Define a governance-compliant autonomy policy, review gates, and promotion criteria.

skills_used.name: interaction-logging
skills_used.purpose: Append the policy creation and validation evidence to the JSONL audit log.

suggestion: Keep the initial autonomy tier conservative and require evidence before higher-level promotion, especially with two newer engineers in the team.
human_decision: The user required the policy artifact and an audit record that explicitly references the policy file, governance-review, and interaction-logging.
action_verification: The autonomy policy was written to docs/autonomy-policy.md and reviewed against the required production-safe structure and governance controls.
limitation: This policy is a governance artifact for production delivery; it is not a statement that the current demo app already auto-bumps dependencies.

human_validation.result: Confirmed the policy includes all required sections and that the day-one level is intentionally conservative for a team with new engineers.
human_validation.outcome: Autonomy policy creation and audit logging complete.

outcome: The autonomy policy defines a safe, progressive approval model for dependency bumps and documents the production-safe governance controls needed to move engineers up the autonomy ladder.
